an9.38:1.1: Cosmologists speculated about the extent of the cosmos (cf. Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad 3.3.1).
an9.38:2.1: Sources for Pūraṇa Kassapa are slim, but he was regarded as a great teacher of the Ājīvakas, whose founder the bamboo-staffed ascetic Gosāla was said to be omniscient (Basham, *History and Doctrines of the Ājīvikas*, 275–6).
an9.38:2.5: Extant Jain texts have no shortage of such claims (eg. Sūyagaḍa1.6, Kalpasūtra 1, Bhagavatisūtra 4.10, etc.), and it seems likely that this was part of Mahāvīra’s teachings.
an9.38:2.8: Here the MS reading is obviously wrong. Also see BB’s interesting note, which establishes that this is, in fact, a misrepresentation of Mahavira’s views.
